explanation: Active only at D1, and only when the previous trial went a1->S1 by the common route and was rewarded (not after a rare a2->S1); it is 0 at GO and D2 in every trial, and also 0 at D1 after no reward or after a reward from S2. When active it is usually 8-10: 9-10 in the second and later of a run of rewarded S1 trials and late in the episode (trial 70 onward), about 7-8 for the first rewarded trial after a miss, and weaker earlier in the episode (about 5-8 around trials 5-45, sometimes only 1-3).
